description: This file defines the class FormatWithDate, which implements the ValueFormatter interface to provide custom formatting for DateTime objects, converting them to a 'Y-m-d' string format.

classes.name: FormatWithDate
classes.description: A formatter class that formats DateTime objects into 'Y-m-d' string representations.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted date string if the input is a DateTime instance; otherwise, returns null.
